tools.name: get_profile_photo_specs
tools.description: Official profile and cover photo requirements (pixel limits, file size, formats, content rules) for LinkedIn personal profiles, LinkedIn company Pages, Slack and GitHub, quoted from each platform's help pages with source links. Values the platform does not publish are null. Omit platform to get all.

tools.name: get_headshot_guide
tools.description: How to shoot or choose a professional headshot for a given use (LinkedIn, resume/CV, company website team page, executive bio, speaker/press kit) and industry: framing, background, attire, expression and what to avoid. Style guidance, not an official platform rule.

tools.name: audit_headshot
tools.description: Score one photo 0-100 as a professional headshot and list concrete issues and fixes (lighting, framing, face visibility, background, attire). Takes a public https URL to a JPEG/PNG/WebP image. Free: 5 audits per day per user. The photo is analysed and not stored.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_headshot · Private data: get_profile_photo_specs · Public sink: get_profile_photo_specs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_headshot · Private data: get_profile_photo_specs · Public sink: get_profile_photo_specs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
